product.title: Norix DuraVision Impact-Resistant Half Dome Security Mirror – MHD
product.body_html:
The Norix DuraVision Impact-Resistant Half Dome Security Mirror is a polycarbonate convex mirror with a 180° view, made for correctional and behavioral health facilities. In cells and isolation rooms, it lets staff see the blind corners to the right or left of the entry door without putting themselves or others in harm's way.

Behind the 1/8” polycarbonate mirror, a fully enclosed urethane foam insert reduces flexing and adds strength, and the powder-coated steel frame mounts flush to the ceiling or wall with countersunk holes for tamper-resistant fasteners. The mirror comes in three sizes: 18” × 9” (MHD-18), 24” × 12” (MHD-24), and 36” × 18” (MHD-36).

  • Mirror: 1/8” (3 mm) polycarbonate with a pure silver reflective coating on the inside surface
  • Tensile Strength: 9,400 psi
  • Foam Backing: Fully enclosed urethane foam insert fills the cavity to reduce flexing and add strength
  • Field of View: 180°
  • Frame: 3/16” × 1” powder-coated steel with recessed holes for fastening to any solid, flat surface
  • Mounting: Ceiling or wall
  • Finishes: Silver mirror, Almond frame
  • Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold
  • Warranty: 3-year limited replacement warranty
  • Intended Use: Indoor use only

Available Models and Options

  • MHD-18 – 18” × 9” Mirror: 20” L × 10” H × 5.5” D overall, 5.8 lbs
  • MHD-24 – 24” × 12” Mirror: 25.8” L × 13” H × 7” D overall, 8.1 lbs
  • MHD-36 – 36” × 18” Mirror: 37” L × 19” H × 7.5” D overall, 13.9 lbs

Mounting hardware is not included. Confirm the mounting surface before ordering so the correct tamper-resistant fasteners can be selected.

Applications

The Norix DuraVision Half Dome Mirror helps staff check blind corners in cells and rooms without putting themselves or others at risk.

Typical applications include:

  • Correctional facilities, jails, and detention centers
  • Behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
  • Other secure institutional settings

The half dome is suited to isolation rooms and cells, where staff need to see the blind corners to the right or left of the entry door.

About Norix DuraVision Mirrors

Norix DuraVision mirrors are built for the demanding conditions found in correctional and behavioral health facilities. The line includes full, half, and quarter dome convex mirrors that help staff monitor blind spots, plus round and rectangle stainless steel wall mirrors.

Common characteristics of DuraVision mirrors include:

  • Durable Mirror Materials: Polycarbonate convex mirrors and stainless steel wall mirrors designed for intensive institutional use
  • Steel Frames: Powder-coated steel frames in an Almond finish
  • Tamper-Resistant Mounting: Frames mount flush to the surface and use countersunk screw holes for tamper-resistant fasteners
  • Safety-Conscious Design: Flush, low-profile designs that help reduce tie-off points and places to hide contraband

About Norix Furniture

Norix manufactures durable furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, and residential treatment centers. Explore the full line of Norix Furniture at Anchortex.
